summary: Separate a financial command from a read model and an auditable history.
scope: Nubank documents Clojure, Datomic, Kafka and event-sourcing experience. This CQRS walkthrough is a conceptual combination; Datomic facts are not automatically the same as a domain event store.
author: Thoth

sources.title: A digital pine forest: the evergreen cache

componentNotes.client: Submits transfers and reads the current account view.
componentNotes.api: Routes financial commands and balance queries to separate handlers.
componentNotes.command: Validates transfer intent before committing financial facts.
componentNotes.ledger: Preserves immutable financial records for audit and reconstruction.
componentNotes.events: Makes committed changes available to independent consumers.
componentNotes.projector: Builds the queryable balance view from committed changes.
componentNotes.read: Stores prepared balances for inexpensive reads.
componentNotes.query: Serves balance and account views from the read model.
componentNotes.audit: Reads historical facts to support replay and audit.
